title: GP10a pre-measurement artifact — The Distress Ledger
milestone: GP10a — a deterministic monthly sweep that counts decline and changes nothing
baseline_commit: 80b8957 — 'GP9a SHIP: the waste ledger certified — save v19'. Every anchor, literal and measurement in this file was taken against THAT tree, on js/sim.js at 7107 lines. The GP10a roadmap scope text's line anchors are two milestones stale and are NOT used here.
purpose: Pins the baseline, the constants, the four fixtures and every HEAD measurement BEFORE the implementation, so the verification pass compares against numbers that were committed rather than numbers that were discovered. GP7a's provenance gate failed for bundling the pre-measurement with the code; GP9a passed by splitting them.
process_deviation: THIS RUN COULD NOT SPLIT THE COMMITS. The implementation pass was executed under an explicit 'do NOT commit' instruction, so the pre-artifact and the code land in the same working tree with no commit boundary between them. The artifact is nonetheless authored to the same contract — every number below is a MEASUREMENT, taken with the harness described in `instrument`, and the HEAD-side numbers were taken from a clean 80b8957 git worktree, not from the edited tree. Recorded rather than silently dropped.

instrument.sim_arm: node vm: a fresh context per arm containing {console, Math, JSON, Date, performance}, into which js/sim.js is evaluated whole. js/sim.js is DOM-free, so this is the entire dependency.
instrument.baseline_arm: git worktree add <tmp>/gp10a-base 80b8957 — a clean checkout, never the edited tree.

instrument.math_random: UNSTUBBED on every run in this file.
instrument.rollovers: 600 ticks is EXACTLY 25 month rollovers (the %24 gate in tick()). Any protocol phrased in 60/120 rollovers declares its own longer tick count.

C3_sweep_honesty.GATE_CLAUSE_THAT_CANNOT_HOLD_AS_WRITTEN: C3's 'min tally === max tally === 1 for all 6400 indices' is refuted by the design's OWN section 3(b): the GRIDLOCK row calls the shipped trafficNear(i), whose 5x5 probe reads over[] for up to 25 neighbours and up to 4 times each (the ROAD||WIREROAD||XWAY||RAMP chain). ACCOUNTING, measured: 6400 reads are the sweep's own — exactly ONE per tile, which is the clause's actual intent — and the remaining 87679 are trafficNear's, paid by the 1164 zoned tiles that survived the three O(1) rows (1164 x 25 x ~3). Keeping trafficNear is deliberate: it is the same probe gCong uses, which is what makes DISTRESS_T.cong = 0.8 literally the same line growthPass evicts at. The measurable substitute is: min === 1 (every tile visited), distressVisits === 6400, and the sweep's own read count === 6400.

recovery.reading: NOT a self-healing failure and not a leak. The counter means 'consecutive months FAILING', not 'consecutive months dark' — 4 tiles regained power and immediately failed the gridlock row from post-restore re-routing. The design's pinned 247/247 was taken on a fixture where no other row applied. A gate phrased as 'every tile that regains power resets' must be scoped to tiles whose only failing row was DARK.

FX-CRIME.reading: the 19-tile gap is FIRST-MATCH working correctly: those tiles are also dark, and DARK outranks CRIME. The target set for this fixture must therefore be declared as 'POWERED zoned tiles with crime >= 50', on which attribution is exact.

open_design_decisions_surfaced_not_decid.D1: ABAND_W is never assigned anywhere in the GP10 split, yet GP10a's bands (>=6 / >=12) and GP10b's gate 8 are coupled to it. IMPLEMENTED RECOMMENDATION: DISTRESS_ABAND_W_FLOOR = 15 is pinned in GP10a's scope (declared, never read by GP10a) so GP10b cannot choose ABAND_W <= 12 and make the critical band unreachable state. The alternative — expressing the bands as fractions of ABAND_W — is still open and is the user's call.
open_design_decisions_surfaced_not_decid.D2: The distress complaint's SCORE RANK. MEASURED: on seeds 4242 and 1 all 40 complaints in 120 rollovers are `unpowered` at a flat 150, so any score above 150 takes all 40 and starves the only kind the corpus produces. IMPLEMENTED RECOMMENDATION: rank LAST at a flat 30, below crime/poll's 40 floor, as an `else if` after the unpowered branch — so the fax appears only where no shipped grievance qualifies, which keeps 'behaves exactly as before' literally true (confirmed by C2).
open_design_decisions_surfaced_not_decid.D3: Score ALL zoned tiles or only developed ones. IMPLEMENTED RECOMMENDATION: score every zoned tile (the approvalCensus denominator discipline — a developed-only share self-heals), but restrict the S4 tile wash, the BLOCK_DISTRESS advisory and the complaint to lvl > 0, and publish BOTH counts (share and devShare) in distressCensus. This also pre-empts GP10b's contradiction that a lvl-0 'abandoned' tile has no derelict sprite size.
open_design_decisions_surfaced_not_decid.D4: The Blight chip is 0 px visible at the default viewport (host 160 px vs scrollWidth 279 px, measured). That is the already-pending strip-overflow decision, NOT a GP10a defect. GP10a exercises the mode through setMapMode()+renderMinimap(), and chip visibility is reported rather than scored.
